disks.title: FreeDOS Games
disks.description: Small games that run on a 286 with EGA: Senet, Hangman, Eliza, Zmiy and ViTetris. They run straight off the floppy.
disks.license: Free software (GPL, BSD or public domain, per program). See README.TXT on the disk.
disks.help:
Run them straight from A:

  A:\SENET\SENET          the ancient Egyptian board game
  A:\HANGMAN\HANGMAN      hangman, in EGA graphics
  A:\ELIZA\ELIZA          the 1960s chatbot
  A:\ZMIY\ZMIY            a snake game
  A:\VITETRIS\TETRIS16    Tetris. Load the ANSI driver first:
                          DEVLOAD C:\FREEDOS\BIN\NANSI.SYS

TETRIS.EXE on the same disk wants a 386. Use TETRIS16 here.

disks.title: FreeDOS Editors and Tools
disks.description: Doszip Commander, a two-pane file manager, plus the e3 and Freemacs editors and the uHex hex editor.
disks.license: Free software (GPL or BSD, per program). See README.TXT on the disk.
disks.help:
A:\DOSZIP\DZ           Doszip Commander. F10 quits
  A:\E3\E3 FILE.TXT       a small WordStar-style editor
  A:\UHEX\UHEX FILE       hex editor

Freemacs builds its .ED files the first time, so run it from
its own directory and answer Y:

  A:
  CD \FREEMACS
  EMACS

disks.title: Commander Keen 1: Marooned on Mars
disks.description: The shareware episode, version 1.31, as Apogee put it on BBSes. One 360K disk with id's DEICE installer.
disks.license: Shareware. Apogee and id asked people to copy and pass on the unmodified episode.
disks.help:
Put the disk in A: or B:, switch to that drive, and install:

  A:
  INSTALL

Pick drive C and let it make \KEEN. Then:

  C:
  CD \KEEN
  KEEN1
